premises.text: Surgeons cannot see screw path inside vertebrae, so many screws are malpositioned with paralysis risk
premises.evidence_span: up to 23% of all the screws placed during spine surgery are malpositioned

premises.text: Current navigation forces looking away at a distant screen, so surgeons underuse it
premises.evidence_span: all the navigated information is projected on a distant screen

premises.text: A patented see-through visor projects patient anatomy onto the surgeon's retina in real time with depth perception
premises.evidence_span: project the patient anatomy in real time directly onto the surgeon's retina with surgical precision and with outstanding depth perception

premises.text: Business model integrates the visor into existing surgical navigation and imaging systems via OEM partnerships
premises.evidence_span: Our business model is to integrate the visor into existing surgical navigation systems and medical imaging systems
